offering_description.value: Operates online travel platforms for booking accommodations, flights, rental cars, restaurant reservations and other travel services. Serves leisure and business travelers and connects them with hotels, property owners, airlines and other suppliers. Earns mostly commissions on bookings made through its websites and apps.

primary_services.value: online accommodation booking; flight booking; rental car booking; restaurant reservations; travel advertising and payment services

customer_segment.value: B2C: leisure and business travelers booking trips online; B2B: hotels, property owners, airlines and restaurants that list and pay for bookings and advertising

end_markets.value: travel and tourism; hospitality and lodging; airlines; restaurants

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions on accommodation, flight and rental car bookings; transaction or usage fees: payment processing and other booking-related fees; advertising: paid placement and meta-search advertising from travel suppliers
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; transaction or usage fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: runs online marketplaces linking travelers with accommodation and travel suppliers; financial intermediary: intermediates bookings and payments between travelers and suppliers, earning commissions

geography_served.value: global: Operates in over 200 countries and territories, with large presence in Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: online travel brands for accommodations, flights, rental cars, restaurant reservations and meta-search

distribution_channels.value: online: company websites and mobile apps for travelers; partners / resellers: affiliate and partner sites distributing supplier inventory

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer protection, data privacy such as GDPR, competition law and the EU Digital Markets Act, and travel and tax rules

notes: Details are from general knowledge; smaller lines such as flights and restaurants may have changed.
